body:
33 million word puzzles. that is the actual price fans paid to see a tracklist.

september 2023: to unlock the vault-track titles on 1989 (taylor’s version), the rollout ran a scavenger hunt with google. searching her name spilled a blue vault across the results page, and every puzzle a fan solved moved one shared counter. the target was 33 million.

the fandom cleared it in under a day. the puzzle itself crashed at one point under the weight of everyone trying. the titles unlocked anyway.

easter-egg culture as actual infrastructure — and that is one case file out of the thirty inside The Clue Web.
